_comment: Artwork the app ships for 2007 in place of its season pack (Export-SeasonCosmetics.ps1 from the pack). Skin-pack files land under Seasons/2007/ when the player imports it; helmet and visor sponsor layers are built then from the pack's helmets. Teams with hand-painted liveries in the pack race on the generic kit: super_aguri.

<USER_OVERRIDES>
  <LIVERY_OVERRIDE LIVERY="57" NAME="BMW Sauber F1 Team #9" BASELIVERY="BlueMetallic">
    <PREVIEWIMAGE PATH="F1 2007\preview9.dds" />
    <TEXTURE NAME="BODY" PATH="F1 2007\9_BMW.dds" />
  </LIVERY_OVERRIDE>
  <HELMET_OVERRIDE LIVERY="57" BASEHELMET="DEFAULT">

    <TEXTURE NAME="BODY_DIFF" PATH="F1 2007\bmw_body.dds" />
